description: This file contains utility static methods for processing data related to postal codes and measurements such as weight and size, with functionality tailored to package units within a sales or e-commerce system.

classes.name: DataUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for data transformations related to postal codes, weight, and measure units.

methods.name: trimPostalCode
methods.description: Removes all non-alphanumeric characters from the provided postal code string.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Calculates and returns the weight in the appropriate measurement unit (kg or lb) based on store configuration and desired base unit.

methods.name: getMeasure
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size measurement in the appropriate unit (cm or inch) based on store configuration and desired base unit.
